title: Local Advertising Google: Smart Growth for Small Business

facts.fact: Local Services Ads operate on a pay-per-lead model, charging only when a user contacts the business directly by phone call, message, or booking request.
facts.quote: you only pay when an individual contacts you directly via phone call, message, or booking request

facts.fact: Google Guarantee protects homeowners by covering potential claims up to $2,000 for work booked directly through the platform if a project is completed unsatisfactorily, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: the Google Guarantee protects homeowners by covering potential claims up to $2,000 for work booked directly through the platform

facts.fact: Clicks on search headlines, directions, and call buttons are generally billed on a cost-per-click (CPC) model, while branded logo pins on Maps served via automated campaigns can be billed on a cost-per-thousand impressions (CPM) basis.
facts.quote: Clicks on search headlines, directions, and call buttons are generally billed on a standard cost-per-click (CPC) model

facts.fact: Local Services Ads allow businesses to flag invalid leads, such as wrong numbers or calls outside the service territory, in their dashboard for a refund credit.
facts.quote: you can flag the invalid lead within your dashboard for a refund credit

facts.fact: The author states they have more than 22 years of experience helping businesses grow through Google Ads, local SEO, and websites built to convert.
facts.quote: I draw on more than 22 years of experience helping businesses grow through Google Ads, local SEO, and websites built to convert.

facts.fact: Performance Max for store goals replaced legacy Local Campaigns and uses machine learning to place ads across Search, Maps, YouTube, Gmail, and the Google Display Network.
facts.quote: Performance Max for store goals (which replaced legacy Local Campaigns) leverages Google’s machine learning to automate ad placement across all Google channels

facts.fact: For home service contractors, the Google Guarantee badge indicates Google has vetted business licenses, verified active liability insurance, and conducted background checks.
facts.quote: the Google Guarantee badge indicates that Google has vetted your business licenses, verified active liability insurance, and conducted background checks

facts.fact: Local Services Ads appear at the top of the search engine results page, above standard pay-per-click ads and organic listings.
facts.quote: sit at the absolute top of the search engine results page (SERP), appearing above standard pay-per-click ads and organic listings

facts.fact: The page is published with a timestamp of 2026-11-05.
Industry benchmarks cited by the page show 30% to 50% of phone taps translate directly into booked consultations or sales.
facts.quote: Industry benchmarks show that 30% to 50% of phone taps translate directly into booked consultations or sales.

facts.fact: The page states that for restaurants an estimated 50% to 70% of users requesting directions physically visit the location.
facts.quote: For restaurants, an estimated 50% to 70% of users requesting directions physically visit the location.

facts.fact: The page states that for medical clinics and dentists, 60% to 80% of direction requests result in an in-person visit.
facts.quote: For medical clinics and dentists, 60% to 80% of direction requests result in an in-person visit.

facts.fact: The page states that localized Performance Max campaigns can begin testing with monthly budgets between $200 and $350.
facts.quote: localized campaigns using Performance Max can begin testing with monthly budgets between $200 and $350

facts.fact: The page states average cost per lead for home services (plumbing, electrical, HVAC, roofing) ranges from $15 to $85+ depending on local competition.
facts.quote: Home Services (Plumbing, Electrical, HVAC, Roofing): Average cost per lead ranges from $15 to $85+ depending on local competition.

facts.fact: The page states average cost per lead for professional and legal services ranges from $50 to $150+.
facts.quote: Professional & Legal Services: Average cost per lead ranges from $50 to $150+.

facts.fact: The page states typical CPC for healthcare and dental clinics ranges from $1.50 to $6.00, with cost per booked appointment averaging $25 to $60.
facts.value: $1.50 to $6.00 CPC; $25 to $60 per booked appointment
facts.quote: Healthcare & Dental Clinics: Typical CPC ranges from $1.50 to $6.00, with cost per booked appointment averaging $25 to $60.

facts.fact: The page states typical CPC for local retail and dining ranges from $0.35 to $2.50.
facts.quote: Local Retail & Dining: Typical CPC ranges from $0.35 to $2.50

facts.fact: The page states Phase 1 of the LSA migration to Google Ads begins August 2026 for select US home service categories including plumbing, HVAC, electrical, roofing, and house cleaning.
facts.quote: Phase 1 (August 2026): Transition begins for select US home service categories (including plumbing, HVAC, electrical, roofing, and house cleaning).

facts.fact: The page states Phase 2 of the LSA migration is a broader US rollout in late 2026 covering remaining service-area businesses and storefront operations.
facts.quote: Phase 2 (Late 2026): Broader rollout covering remaining service-area businesses and storefront operations across the United States.

facts.fact: The page states Phase 3 of the LSA migration is a global rollout in 2027.
facts.quote: Phase 3 (2027): Global rollout for international markets and remaining niche service categories.

facts.fact: The page states that after migration, LSA budgets shift from legacy weekly lead targets to standard daily budgets.
facts.quote: Budgets shift from legacy weekly lead targets to standard daily budgets consistent with other Google Ads campaigns.

facts.fact: The page states annual re-verification requirements for LSA have been eliminated, while initial license, insurance, and background screening remain mandatory.
facts.quote: annual re-verification requirements have been eliminated, with profile information syncing automatically from your Google Business Profile.

facts.fact: The page states a starting budget of $500 to $1,500 per month provides enough data for small businesses testing local ads to evaluate cost per lead and foot traffic impact.
facts.quote: a starting budget of $500 to $1,500 per month provides enough data to evaluate cost per lead and foot traffic impact.

facts.fact: The page states that in lower-competition suburban markets, focused campaigns can generate results with $300 to $600 monthly.
facts.quote: In lower-competition suburban markets, focused campaigns can generate results with $300 to $600 monthly

facts.fact: The page states Google may reimburse a dissatisfied customer up to $2,000 under the Google Guarantee, with a lifetime limit per customer.
facts.quote: Google may reimburse the customer up to $2,000 (lifetime limit per customer).
